content:
The image shows a leaf with irregular-shaped necrotic lesions. Some lesions are dark and sunken, while others appear as lighter-colored spots. These symptoms, particularly the dark, sunken lesions, are characteristic of Anthracnose. The other options are less likely. Die_Back affects twigs and branches, not typically presenting as leaf spots. Powdery_Mildew would appear as a white, powdery fungal growth. Sooty_Mould would be a black, soot-like coating on the leaf surface.
